profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Staff Software Engineer using strong problem solving, programming, and innovation skills to design and create unique and complex products.

Specialties: Software Design and Development
• 13+ years of software development experience with embedded and mobile devices
• Flutter, Dart, C++, C, Java, JavaScript, Python, HTML5, CSS, Objective-C, ActionScript, Android
• Atom, Eclipse, Code Collaborator, JUnit, jMock, Git, Subversion, Perforce, Maven, Hudson/Jenkins, Sonar, Rally, OpenOffice, Microsoft Office, Google
• Ubuntu Linux, Mac OS X, Windows

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Current: 
- Fuchsia (https://fuchsia.dev/)
- Flutter (http://flutter.io/)
Past:
- Flutter rewrite of Google Nest Hub UI (https://tinyurl.com/hub-flutter)
- Armadillo UI for Fuchsia (https://tinyurl.com/fuchsia-armadillo)
- Nexus Player (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nexus_Player)
- Android TV (https://www.android.com/tv/)

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Worked with third-party media and DRM companies to bring their applications to RIM's BB10 and Android platforms
• Created a high-performance media aggregation application for RIM's BB10 platform
• Led a development team of three developers, designing and creating a high-performance media aggregation
system for a consumer device
• Collaborated with The Astonishing Tribe on-site in Sweden to create a working end-to-end prototype of the consumer device over the course of two weeks
• Optimized SQLite database configuration and structure to be extremely performant for display in an OpenGL-based GUI

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: • Designed, developed, and produced Zengaku, an iPhone application written in Objective-C

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Led a highly-effective development team of five developers, producing project-critical features for a java based middleware client which executes on embedded set-top box platforms
• Delivered all developed code on time, with no escaped defects, and with greater than 90% branch coverage via unit testing
• Taught embedded java based middleware designs and architecture to developers at TiVo and NDS
• Submitted two patent applications for embedded set-top box software inventions
• Created and maintained a continuous integration system for a java based middleware client
• Designed and developed conceptually elegant, highly testable and maintainable object-oriented code as indicated by Testability Explorer and Sonar metrics
• Improved legacy code by applying object-oriented design principles resulting in unit test branch coverage being increased from 40% to over 90% and cyclomatic complexity being reduced by over 400
• Maintained software development blog and collaborated with leaders of other development teams weekly to share ideas for improving quality, excellence, and skill of developers throughout the company
• Mentored junior developers in problem solving and code design, quality, and testability
• Earned ScrumMaster certification and applied Agile principles to daily work life

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Designed and developed a complex runtime optimization system for Collection classes within the .NET framework obtaining performance improvements of up to 18.9%
• Wrote, submitted, and presented a paper at a research conference resulting in a publication and a Master’s Thesis

positions.title: Junior Electrical Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed, implemented, and tested hardware of matchbox-sized GPS tracking device
• Researched and designed a prototype digital audio recorder
• Optimized microprocessor software written in Basic for size, correctness, and speed

positions.title: Hardware Designer (Cooperative Work Experience)
positions.description: • Designed High-Speed Data Link Layer to Physical Layer interface using Verilog and implemented the interface in a FPGA as part of a team

positions.title: Meridian 1 Hardware Engineer (Cooperative Work Experience)
positions.description: • Implemented hardware design changes for a PBX telephone system that increased signal to noise ratio

positions.title: Nuclear Safety Analyst (Cooperative Work Experience)
positions.description: • Verified important nuclear licensing software modeling the thermodynamic behaviour of Uranium fuel within an operating nuclear reactor

positions.title: Statistical Programmer (NSERC Award)
positions.description: • Developed applications comparing the speed and accuracy of Extreme Value Statistical algorithms from eight statistical research papers

publications.title: Per-instance Type Shifting for Effective Data-centric Software Prefetching in .NET
Data-Centric Prefetching of Array-Based Collections in C#
publications.publisher: SCI 2004: the 8th World Multiconference on Systemics, Cybernetics and Informatics · Jul 1, 2004

patents.title: Network Management
patents.description: A system and method for managing networks.
